decisions.reason: As the flagship of a new product line in the growing push toward digital practices, the anamnesis app's value is still uncertain but promising, and it builds on the existing software base, so keeping the option open is cheap and strategically valuable.

The continuing education institute complements the firm's training content and customer relationships at modest ongoing cost, and one year of results is too little to show that its value is unlikely to be realized.

The remote screen-sharing support tool is a low-cost addition to customer support, likely built on standard technology, so there is little reason to abandon it while it keeps supporting service efficiency.
